content.name: Hannah Whitworth
content.title: Marketing Manager
content.summary: Marketing manager with nearly ten years in consumer brands across leisure, interiors and drinks in Yorkshire. Leads a team of four at an independent brewery, where a taproom-first brand relaunch grew direct-to-consumer revenue by £410,000 in two years. CIM-qualified, comfortable owning budget, agency relationships and board reporting.

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Lead a team of four (content, events, CRM and design) and a £320,000 annual budget, presenting quarterly results to the managing director and investors.
Relaunched the core range with a new design agency and taproom-led launch events, taking online shop and taproom revenue from £690,000 to £1.1m in two years.
Negotiated listings support with two regional wholesalers, funding 140 pub point-of-sale kits and adding 62 new free-trade accounts.
Introduced a simple attribution model in GA4 and Shopify reports that showed beer festivals out-earning paid social three to one, so spend was rebalanced.
Coached a junior executive through the CIM Certificate and promoted her to CRM lead after she rebuilt our segmentation.

experience.title: Senior Marketing Executive
bullets: Planned the reopening campaign for three holiday parks after the 2020 closures, filling 87% of summer lodge nights within six weeks of launch.
Managed a £95,000 paid search and social budget with an external agency, cutting cost per booking by 23% through weekly bid and creative reviews.
Wrote and tested pricing messages for off-peak breaks that lifted October half-term occupancy from 58% to 74%.
Built a guest review programme with Trustpilot and post-stay emails, raising review volume fivefold and the average score to 4.6.

experience.title: Marketing Executive
bullets: Produced monthly catalogues and window campaigns for four showrooms, coordinating photographers, printers and store managers to fixed deadlines.
Grew the email list from 11,000 to 27,000 subscribers with in-store sign-up incentives and a spring design competition.
Ran the brand's first Instagram shopping campaign, generating 640 tracked orders worth £182,000 in its opening quarter.

education.details: Dissertation on independent retailer loyalty in West Yorkshire market towns.

courses.name: CIM Level 6 Diploma in Professional Marketing

achievements.title: Regional marketing award finalist
achievements.detail: Brewery relaunch shortlisted for a Yorkshire business marketing award in 2024.

achievements.title: Team development
achievements.detail: Two direct reports promoted internally within 18 months of joining the team.
